rules_text.raw:
Against non-mythic effects, the spell automatically succeeds without requiring a caster level check. Against mythic effects, add your tier to your caster level check. The maximum level of spell this spell can remove is 5 + half your tier.

Augmented (7th): If you expend two uses of mythic power, you can apply a removed enchantment, transmutation, or curse to the creature that originally cast it. The creature must be a valid target of the spell and on the same plane as you, and it gets a saving throw at the effect’s original DC.
rules_text.search_text: Mythic Break Enchantment automatically succeeds against non-mythic effects, adds mythic tier to caster-level checks against mythic effects, and can remove spells up to level 5 plus half the caster's tier. Its 7th-tier augmentation costs two uses of mythic power and can return a removed effect to its original caster on the same plane, with a save at the original DC.

warnings.message: The returned-effect target, same-plane requirement, and original saving throw remain in lossless augmentation text until reusable effect-transfer structures are designed.
